top_stories.title: AI prompt paper retracted by journal after investigation
top_stories.summary: A peer-reviewed journal has retracted a paper about AI prompting following an investigation into its integrity. The case highlights growing concerns about research integrity in academic publishing as AI-generated or AI-assisted content becomes harder to detect and verify.

top_stories.title: Anthropic's Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant's Worst Enemy—Itself [Metered]
top_stories.summary: Anthropic has begun trading on Wall Street in what is described as a record-breaking IPO, but the company faces internal tensions between its safety-focused mission and the pressures of operating as a publicly listed company. The piece examines how Anthropic's 'good guy' reputation in AI safety could be tested by the demands of investors and commercial growth.

top_stories.title: Generative AI Disclosure Cannot Fully Capture Manuscript Provenance in Scholarly Publishing
top_stories.summary: A new study argues that current generative AI disclosure requirements in academic publishing are insufficient to fully capture how AI was used in creating manuscripts. The authors contend that existing frameworks fail to account for the complexity of AI involvement across different stages of research and writing, leaving significant gaps in transparency.

top_stories.title: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
top_stories.summary: Google is integrating AI chat functionality directly into its search homepage, marking a significant shift in how the company presents its core product to users. The move reflects Google's ongoing effort to embed generative AI more deeply into its main search interface.

top_stories.title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
top_stories.summary: Google has launched computer-use capabilities for Gemini on macOS, allowing the AI assistant to interact directly with the user's desktop environment. This positions Gemini as a more capable AI agent for Mac users, competing with similar features from other AI labs.

further_links.title: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic's 'good guy' reputation is on the line
further_links.summary: The Verge examines how Anthropic's public listing tests whether its safety-first mission can survive the pressures of being a publicly traded company.

further_links.title: Can AI Save Peer Review from AI?
further_links.summary: An analysis of whether AI tools can be deployed to detect and counter the flood of AI-generated content threatening the integrity of academic peer review.

further_links.title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
further_links.summary: OpenAI has added Live Dictation to ChatGPT, enabling real-time speech transcription as users speak.

further_links.title: Google Built a Giant 'Mirror Dimension' Internet to Test Its Chrome AI Agents [Metered]
further_links.summary: Google created a large-scale simulated internet environment to safely test AI agents operating within the Chrome browser before public deployment.

further_links.title: AI isn't replacing your job. It's turning it into low-paid gig work
further_links.summary: Rest of World reports on how AI is restructuring labour markets by fragmenting skilled work into lower-paid, piecemeal gig tasks rather than eliminating jobs outright.

further_links.title: Canva adds an AI 'off' button
further_links.summary: Canva has introduced a toggle allowing users to disable AI features across its platform, responding to user demand for more control over AI involvement in their workflow.

further_links.title: Court: 4th Amendment Disallows Use Of AI-Generated 'Probable Cause'
further_links.summary: A US court has ruled that AI-generated probable cause assessments are incompatible with Fourth Amendment protections, raising significant legal questions about the use of AI in law enforcement.

further_links.title: The AI Superintelligence Debate Has Serious Flaws
further_links.summary: IEEE Spectrum critiques the assumptions and reasoning underpinning mainstream debates about AI superintelligence, arguing that key claims lack rigorous grounding.

further_links.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
further_links.summary: Apple has posted job listings for engineers to develop an in-house AI agent, signalling the company's ambitions to build more capable autonomous AI functionality.

further_links.title: Why AI-enabled scientific research is a double-edged sword
further_links.summary: An analysis of how AI tools are simultaneously accelerating scientific discovery and introducing new risks around reproducibility, bias, and research integrity.
